# Varseno Solutions

> Varseno Solutions delivers AI-powered custom software development, product engineering, and legacy application modernization services with global delivery from USA, UK, and India.

Varseno specializes in rapid MVP development, web applications, and enterprise AI integration, combining modern technologies like Python, cloud solutions, and test automation frameworks. The company focuses on user-centric design and business intelligence transformation for B2B clients.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered software development
- Custom software development
- Product engineering
- MVP development
- Legacy application modernization
- Web applications
- Test automation (BrowserStack, Cucumber)
- Python development (virtualenv)
- Cloud solutions (Azure, multi-cloud, hybrid cloud)
- Data Mesh architecture
- Business intelligence
- Generative AI implementation
- Cross-browser testing
- Requirement elicitation
- User-centric AI/ML design
